row:
Darquinn Animal Rescue Association is dedicated to giving abandoned and vulnerable animals a second chance at life here in France. Through rescue, rehabilitation, and rehoming, we work every day to provide care, love, and hope to animals in need. Follow our journey, meet our rescues, and help us make a difference—one life at a time.
But we can’t do this alone.
If you’d like to support our mission and help us save more lives:
🐾 Donate via PayPal: www.paypal.me/parellilea
🐾 Join our Teaming (just €1/month): www.teaming.net/darquinnanimalrescue
Your support means food, medical care, shelter—and hope for animals who have none.
Follow us on Facebook to stay connected, and thank you for being part of this journey. Together, we are changing lives—one rescue at a time. 🐶🐱💛
